name: Ruad Rofessa

attributes.attribute: name means the red one who has great knowledge
given to several Irish deities including the Dagda
also used of Donn, an Otherworld figure
may be an ancestral god or an honor title

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Ruad Rofessa is an Irish god. The name means a red one who holds great wisdom. Several Irish deities carried this name, most notably the Dagda, the god of fertility. It was also used of Donn, the shadowy Otherworld figure of death. The tales about Ruad Rofessa are tangled and hard to follow. It is unclear whether he began as his own ancestral god and later joined other deities, or whether the name was only an honorific title.

okr.objective: Present Ruad Rofessa as a name shared by several Irish deities.
key_results: The name means the red one who has great knowledge.
